machine_type.description: The emulated machine type for SPARC architecture. Common values: sun4m (legacy 32-bit), sun4u (UltraSPARC 64-bit), leon3.

accelerator.description: The accelerator backend. 'tcg' for software emulation. 'kvm' if hardware virtualization is supported for the specific SPARC variant.

memory.description: Guest RAM size. Accepts suffixes like M (megabytes) or G (gigabytes).

cpus.description: Number of virtual CPUs to simulate. Depends on machine type support for SMP.

boot_order.description: Boot order string. Letters depend on architecture; 'd' usually CD-ROM, 'c' hard disk for SPARC.

hda_image.description: Path to the hard disk image file for the first IDE drive.

cdrom_image.description: Path to the CD-ROM/DVD image file.

prom_envs.description: List of OpenBIOS PROM environment variables to set. Each item is a string 'key=value'. Used for configuring boot device, auto-boot, etc.

usb_enabled.description: Enable USB emulation. Note: sun4m machines might not have on-board USB controllers by default.

vnc_port.description: VNC display port number. 0 disables VNC. 5900 + display is the typical port calculation, but QEMU handles this.

kernel_cmdline.description: Kernel command line arguments for direct kernel boot.

kernel_image.description: Path to the kernel image for direct boot.

initrd_image.description: Path to the initial RAM disk image.

dtb_image.description: Path to the Device Tree Blob (DTB) image. Required for some SPARC64 direct kernel boots.

nodefaults.description: If true, disables all default devices (serial, parallel, VGA, etc.).

serial_console.description: Serial console destination. 'stdio' for standard input/output.

net_model.description: Network card model. 'lance' (Am7990) is standard for sun4m. 'ne2k_pci' for sun4u.

net_mac.description: MAC address for the network interface. If empty, QEMU generates one.
